headline: State academic testing results for 2026, natural gas equipment replacement, and a $653,933.55 budget transfer.
summary: The agenda covers 2026 state accountability and academic testing results (Part 1). It also covers replacing natural gas powered equipment and a late bus issue at Medford High School.
items: Approval of budget transfers: Journal Entry #21162 for $653,933.55
Approval of donations: $500 from First Baptist Church to the Medford High School Best Buddies Chapter
Approval of donations: $250 from First Baptist Church to the Medford Middle School Best Buddies Chapter
State Accountability & Academic Testing Results 2026 (Part 1), presented by Dr. Kim Talbot
Natural Gas Powered Equipment Replacement, presented by Mr. Kenneth Lord
Medford High School Late Bus, presented by the Student Advisory Council
Presentations of the Public, not before 7:00 pm
location: Howard Alden Memorial Chambers, Medford City Hall, and remote participation via Zoom
